senses.gloss: (Saf. of אנק, ענק; cmp. Assyr. סנק, Del. Assyr. Handw.) to press, stuff.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:1">Tam. II, 1</cite> <he>סוֹנְקִין אותן וכ׳</he> (Talm. ed. <he>סוֹלְקִין</he>) they press them against the sides of the altar.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 2:6">Mikv. II, 6</cite> <he>המְסַנֵּק את הטיט וכ׳</he> if one presses the mud against the sides of the pool.
